name: Yonemori Satoru
source:
One of the original participants.

He is a sorrowful psychiatrist who is shown to be very judgmental of his peers. He's very proud of his hairstyle, which he styled after the protagonist in his favorite manga, Black Jack.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Satoru_Yonemori]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]

One of the original participants.

He is a sorrowful psychiatrist who is shown to be very judgmental of his peers. He's very proud of his hairstyle, which he styled after the protagonist in his favorite manga, Black Jack.
